svg.title: Wiring diagram: SolaX inverter to RS485 module to Wemos D1 mini
svg.desc: Network cable pin 4 (blue) goes to A, pin 5 (blue-white) goes to B and optionally pin 3 (green-white) goes to GND on the RS485 module. On the module, VCC goes to 3V3, GND to GND, DI to D7, RO to D6, and DE and RE are joined and go to D5 on the Wemos D1 mini. The D1 mini is powered over USB.
svg.text: Three parts, eight wires (one optional). Every wire is labelled; the colours only help.
USB: power from a phone charger
data from the D1 mini to the inverter
data from the inverter to the D1 mini
network cable wire (striped = white with colour)
dashed box: optional 1 kΩ resistor (see the build guide)
